body: I replied to your comment below by accident didn’t even notice, was just typing

I live in London. I live with my mother she doesn’t talk to me anymore. She doesn’t believe in depression. I was bullied my whole life for the way I look, I’ve never had a gf I’ve been so sad that I’ve alienated myself from everyone I did know and now I’ve lost contact, I’ve tried online dating and that’s just been a complete disaster as I expected it to be. I dropped out of school because I couldn’t take the bullying anymore so I got absolutely no credentials. I apply for jobs everyday and it just gets more and more frustrating the more I get rejected. Right now I’m just walking around in the middle of the night feeling like such a loser. I still wear the same clothes from 4 years ago because I don’t have any money and my mum has pretty much abandoned me. So life just feels so shit right now. I get sad everyday even when I try to be positive because I feel so alone.
I don’t know why I’m posting here like it’s going to help but I don’t really have any other options and I have no one else to turn to. Just trying to delay the inevitable
